create_ema_callback: create an EMACallback with a decay value to maintain exponential moving averages of model parameters in PyTorch Lightning
test_ema_callback: test the EMACallback to copy EMA shadow parameters to model weights before validation and restore after
refactor_ema_callback: refactor the EMACallback to update EMA averages only after gradient accumulation batches complete
summarize_ema_callback: summarize how the EMACallback saves and loads EMA state in PyTorch Lightning checkpoints
run_ema_update: run the ExponentialMovingAverage.update method to apply exponential decay to model parameters
